editorial:
Imagine you are on a romantic getaway with your partner in a fancy treehouse high up in the woods. It sounds like a dream until you wake up in the middle of the night to see your boyfriend fall 20 meters to his death right before your eyes. Now you are stuck way up in the air, alone and terrified, with no easy way down. The movie does a great job of making you feel how scary it is to be trapped in the sky while something creepy lurks in the trees around you.

The acting is solid and the tension builds up quickly, keeping you on the edge of your seat. While some of the slow parts might bug you, the big scares and the twist make it worth the wait. If you love movies that make you feel trapped, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: You find out that the fall was not an accident. A strange creature has been hunting the couple from the shadows. In the final scenes, the woman fights for her life as the monster tries to pull her from the cabin. She manages to trick the creature and escape just in time, but the very last shot shows the monster is still out there, meaning it is not truly gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and scary settings.
